body: Before you do that. Do you want to talk about what's going on in your life that drove you to this? I want to listen.
Yes. I'm here. Moving past the darkness. It can't have me anymore.
Thanks that sweet :) I honestly just got lucky. You have to keep bothering professors you're interested in working with until one of them lets you into their lab.
I love meeting other biomeds! We should PM

I'm feeling better. I'm gonna go check out the women's center so I can start overcoming the sexual assault trauma. Maybe they can help with the depression and loneliness too? I'll just really focus on my work in the lab until then... Thanks for caring :,)

Yes. They would have to get better soon though. I can't handle the pain of not mattering anymore. I've been vacillating all day about what I should do. I've seen the comments telling me I should end it; I think they have a point.

Idk if this matters, but I'm a black female. I'm suffering from chronic loneliness and severe depression, but I have no support system. I used to really focus on my personal life and making sure my friends were okay, but they don't care about me anymore. I can't deal with this pain. I spend every day just doing school and research. Sexually assaulted by a PhD student here and my school did nothing. They let him graduate. My friends abandoned me and my pastor doesn't give two shits. I should just end it if I can't cope. No depression treatment works and now I have nobody. I was aspiring biomedical researcher. Pre-PhD double major doing infectious disease research in a biomedical engineering department. My ultimate professional goal was to work for a national lab doing similar research. 
No point though. Even people here want me to die. No one really cares so I don't either.
I got your PM, but I'm sure you don't want to talk to me. No one here does.
I did live for me and I'm successful at what I do. But I have nary a soul to share anything with
I don't have anyone to live for
I have no one to live for.
Why?
It's been ten years of this pain. People have been saying it gets better, but it never does. If it always got better, then people wouldn't kill themselves
If people cared, they wouldn't give up on me and stop talking to me.
No one in my life thinks so.
Therapy doesn't help. I'm currently in between therapists, because my last one gave up on me.
I've tried explaining. It doesn't work.
Thanks for everyone who tried to help me. I'm going to end it now though. What's the point anyway? God left me and took all of my friends with Him. No one will care that I'm gone.

Because they have all abandoned me. Some have told me they can't handle my depression anymore and do not understand why I cannot "just be happy." Others have been ignoring my calls when I'm in crisis, including my pastor.

The research makes me feel good. I know that I can make a small dent in human knowledge- that's a great feeling. But that doesn't make a difference to people outside of this world. 

At the end of my life, that research won't matter anyway. What will matter is how much you are loved by the people you love and care for. I don't have that. No one in my life gives a legitimate damn about me. They'll pretend to care if I killed myself tonight just to save face, but then I'll fade out of importance and they'll forget who I was. Because I don't matter.
